items.title: Print archive
items.body: Every 3MF, photo, and timelapse stored locally with full-text search and source-hash chain of custody.

items.title: Telegram bot
items.body: Control printers, manage queues, get actionable notifications — multi-chat with role-based permissions.

items.title: Multi-printer queue
items.body: Background dispatch picks the right idle printer based on filament, model, and AMS mapping.

items.title: Camera & streaming
items.body: Live snapshots, MJPEG/RTSP/USB camera support, OBS overlay built in.

items.title: Maintenance reminders
items.body: Per-printer counters with overdue alerts in UI and Telegram. Mark done from anywhere.

items.title: Self-hosted
items.body: Your data on your hardware. SQLite or Postgres. No cloud account required, ever.
